## Checklist

### Required
- [ ] My code follows the [Uibrium code style](CONTRIBUTING.md) (TypeScript + Tailwind + Radix)
- [ ] I have tested in both **light and dark mode**
- [ ] I have verified **keyboard navigation** works
- [ ] I have run `pnpm build` and it **passes without errors**
- [ ] I have run `pnpm typecheck` and it **passes without errors**
- [ ] No console errors or warnings

### Recommended
- [ ] I have added / updated **Storybook stories** for any changed components
- [ ] I have updated the **documentation** if the public API changed
- [ ] I have added JSDoc comments to any new props or exports
- [ ] I have tested in Chrome, Firefox, and Safari
- [ ] I have checked screen reader behavior (VoiceOver / NVDA)
